seriesName: H100 Neocloud rental price, median $/GPU-hour by period
notes: All four points come from one table on a single Silicon Data article ('H100 Rental Price Over Time (2023-2025)'), published 2025-12-21. 'Neocloud' is Silicon Data's tier label for providers like Lambda, CoreWeave, etc. -- the same category Lambda's own pricing (cited in the bullet: H100 SXM at $3.99-$4.29/hr on-demand today) belongs to. Values used are the article's own stated MEDIAN ('med') figures for each period, not ranges -- ranges (e.g. $3.00-$4.19) were left out per the bare-number rule. The table also has Hyperscaler and Marketplace tiers with their own medians on the same page if a supply/demand-style comparison is wanted instead; only Neocloud was pulled here as the closest match to Lambda's category. Periods are multi-month buckets as published by the source, not single dates, except the 2025-06 row which is a single month. This shows Lambda-category (neocloud) H100 pricing holding in the roughly $3.00-$3.50/hr median band through late 2025, i.e. well below the bullet's current $3.99-$4.29 on-demand figure from Lambda's own site -- consistent with the bullet's point that prices have not come down, if anything Lambda sits above this recent neocloud median trend.
